source_role_change: Final roles match initial screening plan. An unpublished alternative moving vegetation to validation was rejected because that source is needed to develop candidate rules; no model calls or training occurred under that draft.
unnumbered_equations: p23-1/p24-1 are editorial locators for genuinely unnumbered printed equations, not invented printed equation numbers.
chain_equation_normalization: Parentheses around A_p-A_r preserve the printed mathematical value and prevent the old suffix parser treating A_r as an extra assigned output. This is visual transcription, not an automatically fixed global parser.
formula_transcription: Manually verified PDF images. Machine symbols use underscores/prime suffix; printed subscripts/primes preserved in evidence.
conditional_boundary: Vegetation formulas 2 and 4 are alternative primary equations, the latter applies when total cross-section area exceeds BA_prime. Formula 3 is auxiliary for the correction factor, not a primary VQI equation.
